images.alt: SERGIK in desert landscape at golden hour overlooking Phoenix
images.description: Desert portrait at golden hour - contemplative profile view overlooking vast desert landscape with mountains, lake, and sparse desert vegetation. Warm golden light, reflective sunglasses, gold chain visible.

images.alt: SERGIK on rooftop at night with city lights
images.description: Urban rooftop portrait at night - man bun, full beard, heavily tattooed forearms, silver chain. Warm Edison string lights and city skyline bokeh in background. Relaxed, intimate evening setting.

images.alt: SERGIK performing with intense green stage lighting and geometric elements
images.description: Live performance with dramatic green lighting - bucket hat, Off-White jacket, orange-tinted sunglasses on chain. Geometric stage props with orange-red glow, crystalline reflective pillar. Pioneer DJ setup, warehouse/underground atmosphere.

images.alt: SERGIK in studio with red and yellow LED lighting
images.description: Studio session - fedora hat, SERGIK logo t-shirt, red tufted couch. Geometric LED light panels (hexagonal/diamond patterns) in yellow/orange/red/purple. Professional audio equipment, acoustic panels, DAW visible on laptop. Dog companion in foreground.

images.alt: SERGIK DJing with Pioneer equipment, purple and orange lighting
images.description: Performance from behind - Off-White jacket with four-arrow logo, bucket hat. Pioneer DJ equipment, dramatic purple and orange/yellow stage lighting with atmospheric haze. Club/warehouse setting.

images.alt: SERGIK portrait at sunset with palm trees
images.description: Sunset portrait - dark wavy hair, full beard, dark sunglasses. Hands clasped in contemplative gesture. Heavy forearm tattoos. Vibrant orange/yellow/pink sunset sky, palm tree silhouette. Desert/tropical evening atmosphere.

images.alt: SERGIK performing with intense red and blue lighting
images.description: Intense performance - profile view, bucket hat, Off-White jacket with diagonal stripes, Supreme logo visible. Pioneer DJ mixer in foreground. Dramatic red and blue stage lighting creating high-energy underground atmosphere. Active mixing, focused expression.

images.alt: Multiple performers on stage with red and blue lighting
images.description: Collaborative performance scene - three performers on stage. SERGIK in foreground with Pioneer DJ setup, red/blue lighting. Other performers with fedora hats, abstract graphic banner in background. Energetic underground electronic music event.

images.alt: Close-up of SERGIK performing with dramatic red-orange and blue lighting
images.description: Intimate close-up performance moment - full beard illuminated by blue light, over-ear headphones, dark cap. Jacket with angular chevron pattern on sleeve glowing red-orange. Vertical light streaks, deep blue ambient background. Focused, immersed in performance.

images.alt: Club scene with neon ALL YOU graffiti and colorful finger lights
images.description: Dark club scene with neon blue 'ALL YOU' graffiti text and glowing heart. Person with colorful finger lights (red, green, blue, orange) interacting with another person. Green glow on head, warm reddish-orange light on face. Intimate, mysterious rave atmosphere.

images.alt: DJ booth view with blue and red laser lights over dance floor
images.description: Over-the-shoulder view from DJ booth - Pioneer DJ mixing console with illuminated controls. Dense crowd on dance floor. Intense blue laser beam from upper left, red laser grid pattern on ceiling. Haze/smoke effects, neon green scaffolding. High-energy club atmosphere.

images.alt: SERGIK in desert with ELATED t-shirt overlooking mountains and lake
images.description: Desert landscape portrait - person with ELATED t-shirt graphic, dark hair, beard, sunglasses on head, gold chain. Vast desert with red-brown mountains, saguaro cacti, and distant blue lake. Clear blue sky, bright sunny day. Expansive natural beauty.

images.alt: SERGIK DJing with blue lighting and illuminated mixer controls
images.description: DJ performance in blue-lit environment - hands on mixer with colorful illuminated buttons (blue, green, orange/yellow). Gold bracelet visible, dark clothing, headphones. Metal truss structure in background. Low-angle perspective, focused on equipment interaction.

images.alt: Full body portrait with Supreme hat and Nike Cortez sneakers
images.description: Full body portrait against black background - black bucket hat with Supreme logo, dark sunglasses, gold chain. Black t-shirt, heavily tattooed forearms. Black shorts, white crew socks, black Nike Cortez sneakers. Focused lighting, strong contrast.

images.alt: SERGIK performing from behind with SERGIK logo on shirt
images.description: DJ performance from behind - dark shirt with prominent SERGIK logo and Eye of Horus graphic in reddish-orange. Pioneer DJ equipment in foreground. Bright backlit tent structure with trussing, warm yellow-orange to purple gradient lighting. Energetic festival atmosphere.

images.alt: Portrait in front of graffiti-covered wall at night
images.description: Urban portrait - person in dark hooded coat, light pants, standing against graffiti-covered wall. Multiple graffiti styles including 'RIOT' in orange, bubble letters, tags. Dimly lit nighttime setting, urban and gritty atmosphere.

images.alt: Close-up portrait with green-lit vault door background
images.description: Close-up portrait - person with dark sunglasses and gold chain, dark t-shirt. Intense neon green lighting illuminating large vault door with circular handles and spokes in background. Industrial, secure facility aesthetic. Dramatic contrast between dark foreground and bright green background.

images.alt: DJ performance with large eye graphic on LED screen
images.description: Live performance - DJ behind console with large abstract eye graphic on LED screen. Eye rendered in glowing orange-yellow with dark brown/black iris patterns. LED candles or cups on console. Dark, atmospheric mood with screen as primary light source.

images.alt: SERGIK DJing with gold-rimmed glasses and chain
images.description: Close-up DJ performance - dark curly hair, full beard, gold-rimmed glasses with delicate gold chain. Large over-ear headphones, heavily tattooed left arm. Warm orange and red lighting. Metal truss structures, speakers, and stage lights in background. Focused on mixing.

images.alt: DJ performance with intense green lighting and haze
images.description: DJ performance bathed in vibrant green light - baseball cap, headphones, light vest over dark shirt. Powerful green spotlights cutting through haze/smoke. Metal truss structure with speakers on left. Red EXIT sign visible. Industrial venue, energetic atmosphere.

images.alt: SERGIK actively mixing with blue stage lighting
images.description: Active DJ mixing - hands on illuminated mixer controls (blue, green, orange/yellow lights). Dark clothing, gold bracelet, headphones. Strong electric blue stage lighting throughout. Metal truss in background. Low-angle perspective emphasizing equipment and technique.

images.alt: Portrait smoking in front of red-lit graffiti wall
images.description: Portrait in club setting - person with beard, dark cap with green emblem, heavily tattooed arm, multi-colored wristband. Smoking cigarette/joint. White brick wall with red graffiti ('NO PLAN', 'SPIN TIME', winged figure). Strong red lighting, crowd in background. Urban, artistic atmosphere.

images.alt: Close-up with hand over mouth and projected pattern
images.description: Dramatic close-up - person with hand covering mouth, intricate swirling concentric circle pattern projected on hand. Strong red light on left side, blue light on right. Headphones, dark hat (fedora). Intense, mysterious mood with contemplative gesture.

images.alt: Two DJs performing together with purple lighting
images.description: Dual DJ performance - main DJ with gold-rimmed glasses and chain, dark collared shirt, mouth open in concentration. Second DJ in background with baseball cap and hoodie. Pioneer DJ equipment, purple/blue lighting. Large venue with truss system and scattered lights. Collaborative energy.

images.alt: Group photo of three people at concert with purple lighting
images.description: Group portrait at indoor event - three people posing. Left: man with bucket hat, smiley face shirt, heavily tattooed. Center: man with yellow/white trucker hat, dreadlocks, arms crossed. Right: person with blonde hair, baseball cap, bomber jacket. Purple/pink lighting, blurred crowd background. Celebratory mood.

images.alt: Two men at outdoor festival at night
images.description: Outdoor festival portrait - two men with open mouths shouting/singing. Left: man with bucket hat (orange emblem), smiley face shirt, gold chain with glasses pendant, heavily tattooed. Right: man with neon green beanie, sunglasses, dark hoodie, holding beverage can. Nighttime setting, blurred crowd and structures in background.

images.alt: Crouching portrait in front of graffiti wall
images.description: Urban portrait - person crouching in front of graffiti wall. Black hooded garment with 'VETEMENTS' logo, dark top, silver chain, tan cargo pants, white/grey sneakers. Orange wristband, ring. Graffiti includes 'RIT' tag in orange, bubble letters, layered tags. Dimly lit nighttime setting.

images.alt: SERGIK performing under bright tent structure
images.description: DJ performance from behind - dark shirt with SERGIK logo and eye graphic. Pioneer DJ equipment on truss platform. Large white translucent tent structure with visible framework, intensely backlit with warm yellow-orange to purple gradient. Two bright white spotlights. Festival/event atmosphere.

images.alt: Portrait with Off-White jacket and Supreme hoodie
images.description: Close-up portrait in blue/purple lighting - person with black beanie, headphones, black puffer jacket with Off-White diagonal stripes and logo. Supreme hoodie visible underneath. Right hand raised to face. DJ equipment in foreground. Dark, energetic club environment.

images.alt: DJ hands on mixer with blue lighting
images.description: Close-up of DJ hands on mixer - colorful illuminated controls (blue, green, orange/yellow). Gold bracelet on wrist. Strong electric blue stage lighting. Dark clothing, headphones visible. Focus on technical mixing, equipment interaction. Low-angle perspective.
